import sys

def main():
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    if not args:
        print("sayı yok")
        return
    numbers = [float(arg) for arg in args]
    average = sum(numbers) / len(numbers)
    print(f"{average:.2f}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
